notes: Book chapter. The book (1898) has no preface; each chapter is a self-contained piece in spoken-address form (for example 'I wish to call your attention to…'). The book itself does not call them sermons. Shares some passages (about a fifth of the wording) with the 'THE PENITENT THIEF' extract in Bible Characters, but it opens differently; kept as a separate entry. Compare also 'The Dying Thief' in Wondrous Love.
